# Choropleth Join

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Rows joined onto boundaries by a key: US states, world countries or Canadian provinces. A row per boundary with its geometry, its name and codes (`name`, `abbrev`, `fips`, `iso2`, `iso3`) and the matching row's columns; a boundary no row matches keeps only its own. The key's kind (a name, an abbreviation, a FIPS or ISO code) is detected from the values when left on Auto. Runs in the engine; the boundaries are fetched once.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "choropleth-join", "name": "choropleth-join", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->

<!-- gen:end params -->
